# Billing API

Inspect plans, subscription state, resource use, and managed AI usage.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/billing/plans` | [List billing plans](#op-get-v1-team-billing-plans) |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/billing/subscription` | [Get subscription](#op-get-v1-team-billing-subscription) |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/billing/resources` | [Get resource usage](#op-get-v1-team-billing-resources) |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/billing/ai-usage` | [Get AI usage](#op-get-v1-team-billing-ai-usage) |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/billing/token-packs` | [List AI token packs](#op-get-v1-team-billing-token-packs) |

## List billing plans {#op-get-v1-team-billing-plans}

`GET /v1/team/billing/plans`

Read the public plan catalog.

Authentication: public; no bearer token required.

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/team/billing/plans"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

Successful response. Inspect returned state for operations that start asynchronous work.

A complete response-body schema is not published for this custom operation. Inspect the returned content and status; no payload is assumed here.

## Get subscription {#op-get-v1-team-billing-subscription}

`GET /v1/team/billing/subscription`

Read the selected team's subscription.

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/team/billing/subscription" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

Successful response. Inspect returned state for operations that start asynchronous work.

A complete response-body schema is not published for this custom operation. Inspect the returned content and status; no payload is assumed here.
